scope: Manual review of door arcs, leaf lines, wall gaps, and their coarse room relationship. It is not a GT comparison, automated acceptance result, human approval, or input to a generator.
coordinate_note: Pixel boxes are [left, top, right, bottom] in the original PNG. They bound cyan door-leaf/arc ink, not a calibrated doorway edge; world endpoints remain approximate.

overall.main_model_progress: The two F2 office-to-office connections present in run02 were changed to corridor connections in run03. This corrects the room relationship, but two old corridor-door records remain as extra doors.
overall.remaining_f1_error: F1 still contains two fabricated left-side doors at the second vertical partition: D_F1_N2_Cb and D_F1_S2_Cb.

limitations: This review was performed after run03 completed and is stored only in its evaluation directory. It was not supplied to the run03 subscription/model and must not be supplied to the independent run04 generator.

Earlier quick review incorrectly counted a left-side door at the second F1 vertical partition. Enlarged original-image inspection corrected that error: only the right-side N3/S3 leaves exist there. This file supersedes that earlier count.
Cyan external-wall marks without a door leaf/arc were treated as windows, not doors. Furniture outlines and green dimensions were not treated as opening evidence.
Pixel evidence supports object existence, coarse side, and room relationship. It does not validate all candidate dimensions, hinge state, construction, drawing fidelity, or the source BIM as a whole.
